Indian Railways approves anti-collision system for Northern Zone

The Ministry of Railways has approved the installation of the indigenous 'Kavach' anti-collision system on a 680-kilometer route in the Northern Zone. The project has been allocated ₹206 crore for implementation. This move aims to enhance safety on the railway network.
